description: Circle of fifths: turns a key and a mode into the control voltages that drive the chord sequencers and quantisers, and steps round the circle on triggers

params.text: Sets the key the circle starts from, C to B, shown in red on the circle
Sets the mode, Ionian through Locrian

inputs.text: A trigger moves the position one place anticlockwise round the circle and the ROOT output follows; a trigger arriving here and at ROT R at once returns to the key the ROOT knob sets
A trigger moves the position one place clockwise round the circle and the ROOT output follows; a trigger arriving here and at ROT L at once returns to the key the ROOT knob sets
A voltage here sets the starting key, in place of the ROOT knob; 0V to 10V spread across the twelve keys, or read as a 1V/octave pitch if the menu says so
A voltage here sets the mode, in place of the MODE knob; 0V to 10V spread across the seven modes

outputs.text: The current key as a voltage for the root input of Progress, Bombe, Galaxy or Scale Quantizer
The current mode as a voltage, 0V to 10V across the seven modes, for the mode input of Progress, Bombe or Galaxy

menu: Input Volt Scaling — how the ROOT input is read: V/Oct takes it as a 1V/octave pitch, Classic as the twelve keys spread across 0V to 10V
Output Volt Scaling — how the ROOT output is written: V/Oct writes a 1V/octave pitch, Classic the twelve keys spread across 0V to 10V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the ROOT knob's setting.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the MODE knob's setting.
